html:
df-linear-logic — Propositional Classical Linear Logic

[Hypothesis]

  • \(P\) 是原子名集合，字面量是互不相交的自由构造树 \(p^+,p^-\)（\(p\in P\)）。下式各连接词、单位和单目符号是互异构造标签；\(\mathbin{⅋}\) 是par符号。语法取有限树，不施加交换或结合的公式等式。
  • 多重集是有限支撑函数 \(\Gamma:\mathcal F_{LL}\to\omega\)；\([A]\) 是 \(A\) 的单元多重集，\(\Gamma,A:=\Gamma+[A]\)，逗号表示逐点加法。\(\vdash\Gamma\) 是下式给定的有序对编码，\(U_{LL}\) 为这些编码的集合；规则分数及 \(\operatorname{Cl}\) 使用 72-df-types-inference-closure。
  • 规则集合中的 \(A,B\) 遍历 \(\mathcal F_{LL}\)，\(\Gamma,\Delta\) 遍历 \(\mathcal M\)。\(R_0\) 是无cut集合，\(R_{LL}\) 是含cut集合；多重集内置交换，不另加一般弱化或收缩。

[Assertion]

[Remark]

所有规则共用同一个单侧有限多重集载体，独立于核心的有序双侧序列。promotion的全部旁公式必须是?公式；加法&两前提共用相同旁多重集，tensor则分拆资源。单位0没有引入规则。递归定义线性否定的全部分支，而非仅断言其为对合。由语法归纳可得双重否定恒等。

links.heading: [Hypothesis]
links.excerpt: 多重集是有限支撑函数 $\Gamma:\mathcal F_{LL}\to\omega$；$[A]$ 是 $A$ 的单元多重集，$\Gamma,A:=\Gamma+[A]$，逗号表示逐点加法。$\vdash\Gamma$ 是下式给定的有序对编码，$U_{LL}$ 为这些编码的集合；规则分数及 $\operatorname{Cl}$ 使用 [[72-df-types-inference-closure]]。

math.tex:
\begin{aligned}
F_0&:=\{p^+,p^-:p\in P\}\cup\{\mathbf1,\bot,\mathbf0,\top\},\\
F_{n+1}&:=F_n\cup\{A\otimes B,A\mathbin{⅋}B,A\oplus B,A\mathbin{\&}B:A,B\in F_n\}\cup\{!A,?A:A\in F_n\},\\
\mathcal F_{LL}&:=\bigcup_{n\in\omega}F_n,\qquad\mathcal M:=\{\Gamma\in\omega^{\mathcal F_{LL}}:|\{A:\Gamma(A)\ne0\}|<\omega\},\\
(\vdash\Gamma)&:=\langle0,\Gamma\rangle,\qquad U_{LL}:=\{\langle0,\Gamma\rangle:\Gamma\in\mathcal M\},\\
[A](B)&:=\begin{cases}1,&A=B,\\0,&A\ne B,\end{cases}\qquad(\Gamma+\Delta)(A):=\Gamma(A)+\Delta(A),\\
0_{\mathcal M}(A)&:=0,\qquad (?\Gamma)(B):=\sum_{\{A:\ ?A=B\}}\Gamma(A),\\
(p^+)^\perp&:=p^-,\quad(p^-)^\perp:=p^+,\quad\mathbf1^\perp:=\bot,\quad\bot^\perp:=\mathbf1,\quad\mathbf0^\perp:=\top,\quad\top^\perp:=\mathbf0,\\
(A\otimes B)^\perp&:=A^\perp\mathbin{⅋}B^\perp,&(A\mathbin{⅋}B)^\perp&:=A^\perp\otimes B^\perp,\\
(A\oplus B)^\perp&:=A^\perp\mathbin{\&}B^\perp,&(A\mathbin{\&}B)^\perp&:=A^\perp\oplus B^\perp,\\
(!A)^\perp&:=?(A^\perp),&(?A)^\perp&:=!(A^\perp),\qquad A\multimap B:=A^\perp\mathbin{⅋}B.
\end{aligned}

\begin{aligned}
R_{id}&:=\left\{\frac{}{\vdash A^\perp,A}\right\},\qquad R_{cut}:=\left\{\frac{\vdash\Gamma,A\quad\vdash\Delta,A^\perp}{\vdash\Gamma,\Delta}\right\},\\
R_\otimes&:=\left\{\frac{\vdash\Gamma,A\quad\vdash\Delta,B}{\vdash\Gamma,\Delta,A\otimes B}\right\},\qquad R_{⅋}:=\left\{\frac{\vdash\Gamma,A,B}{\vdash\Gamma,A\mathbin{⅋}B}\right\},\\
R_1&:=\left\{\frac{}{\vdash[\mathbf1]}\right\},\qquad R_\bot:=\left\{\frac{\vdash\Gamma}{\vdash\Gamma,\bot}\right\},\\
R_{\&}&:=\left\{\frac{\vdash\Gamma,A\quad\vdash\Gamma,B}{\vdash\Gamma,A\mathbin{\&}B}\right\},\qquad R_{\oplus}:=\left\{\frac{\vdash\Gamma,A_i}{\vdash\Gamma,A_0\oplus A_1}:i\in\{0,1\}\right\},\\
R_\top&:=\left\{\frac{}{\vdash\Gamma,\top}\right\},\qquad R_{\mathbf0}:=\varnothing,\\
R_!&:=\left\{\frac{\vdash?\Gamma,A}{\vdash?\Gamma,!A}\right\},\qquad R_{?d}:=\left\{\frac{\vdash\Gamma,A}{\vdash\Gamma,?A}\right\},\\
R_{?w}&:=\left\{\frac{\vdash\Gamma}{\vdash\Gamma,?A}\right\},\qquad R_{?c}:=\left\{\frac{\vdash\Gamma,?A,?A}{\vdash\Gamma,?A}\right\},\\
R_0&:=R_{id}\cup R_\otimes\cup R_{⅋}\cup R_1\cup R_\bot\cup R_{\&}\cup R_\oplus\cup R_\top\cup R_!\cup R_{?d}\cup R_{?w}\cup R_{?c},\\
R_{LL}&:=R_0\cup R_{cut},\\
\vdash_{LL}\Gamma&:\Longleftrightarrow(\vdash\Gamma)\in\operatorname{Cl}_{U_{LL}}(R_{LL}),\qquad\vdash_{LL}^0\Gamma:\Longleftrightarrow(\vdash\Gamma)\in\operatorname{Cl}_{U_{LL}}(R_0),\\
\operatorname{LL}&:=\langle\mathcal F_{LL},\mathcal M,(-)^\perp,R_{LL}\rangle.
\end{aligned}
